text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I had arranged to meet up
with Symboli Kris S, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eep... ! K-Kris S-san
looks super furious... !?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Way too scary...
No way, let's look somewhere else...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, she wore a look of utter fury,
and people were too intimidated to even approach her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: Sorry to keep you waiting... Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Headache.
...A headache.
I took... my medicine, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to bear the pain, Symboli Kris S's expression grew sterner than usual.
Her headache would continue to linger for a while afterward...
